status: Coming to the Chrome Web Store. It installs automatically once Google approves the update.
title: A to Z starts with your seed

changes.text: A to Z research now starts with two extra queries before the letters: your seed on its own, and your seed followed by a space. Google suggests different completions for each, so you get its top suggestions for the seed too (28 queries instead of 26).
Queries that end with a space are marked "+ space" in the query list and while collecting.

status: Released on the Chrome Web Store.
title: Email verification and a theme switch

changes.text: Email verification: new email accounts confirm their address with a 6-digit code sent from no-reply@nichespark.tech, with a "Send a new code" option.
Light and dark theme switch in the popup and dashboard. Your choice is remembered; until you choose, NicheSpark follows your system setting.
First-time sign-in with Google now returns to the extension instead of opening the NicheSpark website.

status: Released on the Chrome Web Store.
title: Accounts and cloud sync

changes.text: Free NicheSpark accounts: sign up with email and password or continue with Google. Signing in is required to use the extension.
Cloud sync: projects, queries and keywords are saved to your account and kept in sync on every computer where you sign in. Collection still works offline; changes upload when you are back online.
Research you collected before 0.4.0 is uploaded to your account the first time you sign in.
Password reset by email, and a sync status with "sync now" next to your account.
Signing out uploads any remaining changes, then removes your data from that browser; it stays in your account.

title: Dashboard controls fixed; Prefix, Suffix and Template ready out of the box

changes.text: Start, Retry failed, Pause, Resume and Cancel in the dashboard now work. Before, they could fail with "The NicheSpark background worker did not respond" because commands from the dashboard tab were rejected.
New projects start with ready-to-use prefix, suffix and template lists, so Prefix, Suffix and Template research work straight away.
The popup offers one-click ready-made lists when a project's prefix, suffix or template list is empty.
In the dashboard, Start is always available: if you've edited a list, "Save list & start" saves it and starts collecting in one click.

status: Released on the Chrome Web Store.
title: Questions, ready-made lists and keyword grouping

changes.text: Questions research method: puts how, what, why, can, is and other question words before your seed, so Google suggests the questions people actually ask.
Ready-made prefix and suffix lists (Commercial, Budget, Pricing, Local, Learning, Business) that you add to a project in one click and can edit before saving.
Keyword grouping: every keyword gets a theme (Questions, Price & cost, Local, Compare & reviews, Business & jobs, Learning & guides), with a Theme filter and column.
Groups by modifier: one-click chips for words that recur after your seed, such as "course" or "prices", to filter the table.
CSV exports include a Theme column.

A to Z research no longer saves Google echoing the unfinished query back, such as "mobile repairing a". Real completions like "mobile repairing app", and prefix or suffix keywords like "mobile repairing near me", are still saved.
A Clean up button in the dashboard removes echo keywords saved by earlier versions, after asking you to confirm.
An A to Z query where Google only echoed the query back is now marked Empty instead of Done.

status: Released on the Chrome Web Store.
title: Export, filters and the Chrome Web Store

changes.text: Search, filters by research method and source query, and six sort orders in the keyword table.
Copy all, filtered or selected keywords, one per line.
CSV export of all, filtered or selected keywords, UTF-8 so Urdu and other scripts open correctly in Excel.
Backup (JSON) for a whole project, and a validated import that always restores as a new project.
Delete selected keywords, with confirmation.
New NicheSpark logo.
New emerald colour scheme and typography in the popup and dashboard.
Live collection of real Google Autocomplete suggestions from a background Google tab.
A to Z, prefix, suffix and template research, with a query preview.
Pause, resume, cancel and retry failed, with progress saved after every query.
Automatic deduplication and source-query tracking for every keyword.
Stops for Google verification or consent pages and never bypasses them; your own search history is never saved.
